item.title: Officers, civilian recognized for rescue of Michigan ice fisherman
item.description: Nearly two years ago, a 63-year-old ice angler struggled for his life on Michigan’s Lake Gogebic, repeatedly falling into the icy surface. A team from several Michigan agencies worked together to rescue Paul Boehm during the March 12, 2024 incident.
